This video contains three excerpts from videos made with artists in our community: Cheryl Mukherji (Workspace AIR ‘24), Sandra Erbacher (2024 Project Gallery Exhibiting Artist, 2025 Risograph Resident), and Victor Sira (Penumbra Faculty), offering a closer look at our Residency, Exhibitions, and Education programming.

To view with closed captioning, please select “CC” on the bottom right corner.

Video excerpt 1: from Cheryl Mukherji’s walkthrough of Wanted Beautiful Home Loving Girl, a site-specific installation on view at her public Open Studios.

Video excerpt 2: from Sandra Erbacher’s discussion of her solo exhibition, a ll i ll w i ll, presented in the Project Gallery and formed in response to the collection of documents produced by the Eugenics Record Office (ERO), located in Cold Spring Harbor, New York.

Video excerpt 3: from Victor Sira’s discussion of his course, The Book: As an Object & As an Idea, which incorporates a study of publications from Penumbra’s Risograph Photobook Collection.
